title: Entry Terms for Payment Protection Plans
content:
Ages, timing and loan size for Payment Protection. Each figure below is set per plan; the six plans carry the same values.

## Entry terms

| Plan | Age of each covered person at enrollment (minimum / maximum, years) | Coverage end age (years) | Enrollment window (calendar days after the loan's funding date) | Free-look period (calendar days after enrollment) | Smallest loan amount financed eligible for a plan | Re-enrollment of a cancelled plan on the same loan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment Protection Life | 18 / 65 | 70 | 30 | 30 | USD 2000.00 | Not allowed |
| Payment Protection Life and Disability | 18 / 65 | 70 | 30 | 30 | USD 2000.00 | Not allowed |
| Payment Protection Complete | 18 / 65 | 70 | 30 | 30 | USD 2000.00 | Not allowed |
| Joint Payment Protection Life | 18 / 65 | 70 | 30 | 30 | USD 2000.00 | Not allowed |
| Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability | 18 / 65 | 70 | 30 | 30 | USD 2000.00 | Not allowed |
| Joint Payment Protection Complete | 18 / 65 | 70 | 30 | 30 | USD 2000.00 | Not allowed |

## What each column means

- **Enrollment ages.** The minimum age and the maximum age of each covered person at enrollment, in years.
- **Coverage end age.** Coverage ends at the first due date after the primary covered person reaches this age.
- **Enrollment window.** The calendar days after the loan's funding date during which the borrower may enroll.
- **Free-look period.** The calendar days after enrollment during which cancelling refunds every fee charged.
- **Smallest loan amount financed.** A loan financed for less than this amount is not eligible for a plan.
- **Re-enrollment.** A cancelled plan cannot be re-enrolled on the same loan.

## Card notes

- The coverage end age (70) is measured against the primary covered person, and the end falls on the first due date after that birthday.
- The enrollment window counts from the loan's funding date; the free-look period counts from the enrollment date. The two periods have the same length in every plan but run from different dates.
